_comment: 2018 JetHT counterpart of trijet_mg_pythia8_2018_rho_skim.json (2026-07-25). Data fills only the `reco` table plus events/alljets; `matched`/`gen` are booked but stay empty, and for data final_seq == recoTot_seq so `reco` means the same thing as in MC. No prescale (unlike dijet's rho_skim10) because the three-AK8-jet requirement plus one measured jet per event already thins the sample ~30x; the MC config uses the same unprescaled mode so data/MC compare bin-for-bin. Run via scripts/run_dijet_skim_split.py --bins Run2018A Run2018B Run2018C Run2018D.
